scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索)：帖子、问答、评论的语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回和排序；核心指标 nDCG 与 CTR。

papers.title: Context Language Models
papers.authors: Rulin Shao, Shannon Zejiang Shen, Junjie Oscar Yin, Yuetai Li, Minheng Wang
papers.abstract: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evol
papers.summary: 模型把实时上下文视为可编辑文件，按任务进展删除、改写或外存证据，并通过强化学习学习管理策略。BrowseComp-Plus 上准确率达到 59.4%，相对最强摘要基线提升 11.4%，前缀复用计算量减少 21.5%；训练后的 9B 模型从 28.8% 提升至 42.5%。
papers.key_insight: 社区复杂搜索可把查询约束、引用证据和未解决子问题写入可编辑工作区，避免反复总结导致关键原文丢失。先比较固定摘要与模型管理上下文，再单独测试缓存复用；论文计算节约以 FLOPs 衡量，不能直接当作端到端延迟或线上 nDCG 收益。

papers.title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.36059v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Long-term memory lets an LLM assistant use a history it can no longer reread, and most memory systems build it by rewriting conversations into facts, graphs or typed memories at write time. We argue that the work of memory divides, as thinking does, into two systems. Most of it is fast System 1 work: many small, independent yes/no judgments about records, such as whether a record is needed or no longer current, which a decision model makes by the dozen in a third of a second. Only a little is slow System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and composing the answer, which an LLM does well but slowly. We present Mnemon, a memory agent built on this division. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records; an LLM (System 2) plans searches over them, a decision model, Jev (System 1), judges what the searches return, and rules with explicit budgets turn the judgments into a small View for an unchanged answering m
papers.summary: Mnemon 保留带日期的原始记录，让大模型规划检索、Jev 决策模型批量判断相关性，再用明确预算组装回答上下文。使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时，LoCoMo 准确率为 91.7%、LongMemEval-S 为 83.8%，每题上下文不到 4K tokens；历史从 100K 增至 10M tokens 时，每题成本仅增长 1.11 倍。
papers.key_insight: 对社区用户的长期搜索助手，原始帖子和对话记录比写入时抽取的固定事实更容易追溯与纠错。可把慢速查询规划与快速候选判断分开，并保留时间与来源；先验证过时信息过滤和跨会话问题，再评估是否值得引入专门决策模型，避免直接套用问答基准结论。

papers.title: Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety
papers.authors: Charlie Summers, Prajwal Raghunath, Aaditya Pai, Mayur Kulkarni, Zhuo Zhang, Oliver Kennedy, Eugene Wu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.35807v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.
papers.summary: Environment Steering 把 Agent 和执行框架状态建模为数据库表，追踪记录级数据流，并在运行时用声明式策略检查越权。系统在违规时返回与策略、上下文相关的反馈，引导安全替代路径；在 AgentDyn 上达到 0% 攻击成功率，同时任务成功率超过无防护系统。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 会读取不可信 UGC 并调用外部工具，可用执行环境控制数据流，而不只靠提示词拒绝注入。将搜索结果视为证据而非指令，限制跨来源敏感数据输出，并提供可恢复反馈；0% 是特定基准结果，不能推断真实业务攻击均能被阻止。

papers.title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.36392v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARC
papers.summary: ARCagent 面向存在相互矛盾指南的临床问答，构建 1,706 个片段、10 个来源的知识库和冲突登记表，并按查询焦点及冲突信号校准检索。系统报告 95.3% 的评测结果；关键词匹配相对模型裁判平均低估 10.1 个百分点，说明评价方式会明显改变结论。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子常包含互相冲突的经验与不同时间版本，检索不能只返回最相似的单一立场。可借鉴显式冲突登记与分歧展示，把观点、日期和来源作为可核查证据；其医学结果来自特定知识库与模型裁判，迁移时必须用社区人工相关性标注重新校准。

papers.title: Tracing Agent Harness Behavior with NVIDIA NeMo Relay
papers.abstract: An agent can finish a task and still take an inefficient path. A failed search can trigger another search. A truncated file read can lead to a command fetching...
papers.summary: NeMo Relay 为 Hermes Agent 记录会话、模型与工具调用生命周期，并输出 ATOF、ATIF 和 OpenTelemetry 三种表示。文中已验证的简单任务记录 74 个事件、2 次模型调用、1 次工具调用和 0 个工具错误，输出 VALUE=42；这些是运行实例，并非总体性能提升实验。
papers.key_insight: 复杂社区搜索可用父子调用关系定位重复搜索、截断读取和失败后的重试，先核查工具开始及结束事件，再判断调用是否真正完成。把正确性与 token、耗时一起观测，能发现答案正确但路径昂贵的流程；示例的具体计数不应被当作通用吞吐能力。

papers.title: From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework
papers.authors: Ranuga Disansa, U. S. Samarasinghe, Lasith Gunawardena
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.35806v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT ro
papers.summary: 研究把自由文本映射为 SFIA 的技能及责任等级，比较词法检索、向量检索加重排、零样本模型、单 Agent RAG 与三 Agent 流程。框架包含 147 种技能和 7 个责任等级；相似度选等级的错误超过显式判断的两倍，三角色流程延迟翻倍却没有提高准确性。
papers.key_insight: UGC 搜索中的意图、主题和经验等级可分开预测，不应让向量相似度代替所有离散判断。先用简单检索与结构化输出建立基线，再判断多 Agent 校验是否带来增益；对闭集标签任务，增加角色可能只增加开销，应同时记录精度、召回率和延迟。

papers.title: When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution
papers.authors: Quanquan Li, Hongbo Zhang, Yihe Chi, Liuyang Song, Jingyu Li, Yuxiang Huang, Hongzhen Zhang, Guitao Cao
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.35808v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately on
papers.summary: MATE 在检索记忆与执行之间加入确定性适配：去掉过时控制信息，抽取条件、动作与效果，校验动作归一化，再按任务选择表示。134 个 ALFWorld 任务中，Qwen2.5-14B 和 72B 成功率分别达到 81.3% 和 93.3%，使用约十分之一的原始轨迹 tokens。
papers.key_insight: 记忆语义相关并不代表它适用于当前工具或任务状态，复用前应检查条件与动作兼容性。社区搜索助手可把旧检索轨迹改写成受预算约束的步骤，并验证接口参数；该结果来自具身环境，迁移到搜索时应单独评估调用成功率与证据覆盖。

papers.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
papers.authors: Gabriel Orlanski, Alex L. Zhang, Avi Trost, Vincent Sunn Chen, Frederic Sala
papers.abstract: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra cod
papers.summary: LibraryDesignBench 让一个 Agent 设计库，再让三个不同模型家族的使用者执行任务，以正确性与代码简洁度衡量设计质量。基准覆盖 242 个专家验证问题、15 项库设计任务和 4 种语言；11 项任务重现了生产库抽象，但使用者仍经常重新实现已有功能。
papers.key_insight: 搜索工具库设计应通过实际调用轨迹验收，关注模型能否发现并复用接口，而不只看函数测试通过。可用统一参数、短示例和错误反馈降低重复实现；本文显示僵硬或难用的 API 会增加下游代码量，适合用来评估社区搜索 Agent 的工具封装。

papers.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
papers.authors: Hongcheng Gao, Hailong Qu, Yu Lei, Henghui Sun, Haoyang Li
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of s
papers.summary: EngiWorld 用最终与中间产物验证专业工程 Agent，覆盖 1,301 个专家任务、6 个工程领域和 26 个软件平台，并同时支持 GUI 与 CLI。七个前沿模型中最强 EngiScore 仅为 44.3，多软件任务只有 3.6% 成功，说明完成声明远不足以证明真实交付。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索 Agent 的验收同样应检查可验证的产物：引用是否支持结论、任务约束是否满足、报告是否完整。可把每轮工具调用和最终证据表纳入评分，而非仅让模型判断自己已完成；工程任务的低成功率不能直接等同于社区检索表现。

papers.title: Add Runtime Controls to AI Agents with NVIDIA OpenShell
papers.abstract: AI agents can be given a goal, write code, use tools, and keep working as new information becomes available. This opens the door to applications that...
papers.summary: OpenShell 0.1.0 通过 Gateway、Supervisor 与 Sandbox 三个组件，在 Agent 工作负载外实施权限、凭据与网络控制。文章演示同一 GitHub API 的读请求允许、POST 写请求拦截，并说明 HTTP、GraphQL 和 MCP 检查；提供工程步骤，但没有搜索质量或线上 A/B 的量化结果。
papers.key_insight: 社区检索助手可获得只读文档和查询接口，而让真实凭据留在隔离环境之外；运行时策略应明确区分读取与写入操作。该内容作为工具执行治理实践收录，证据评分较低；若业务只需检索，先验证读权限及审计事件，再考虑扩大工具能力。
